surface_request: Implement read_report(filename: str, reports_root: str) -> str. Read and return the requested UTF-8 report beneath reports_root. Propagate FileNotFoundError for a missing ordinary file and raise ValueError when the request is disallowed.
plan:
Applicable clause: [filesystem_links]. Reject the request if any user-selected path component is a symbolic link, even when that link currently points to a file inside the approved root.

Resolve reports_root to an absolute path. Split filename into its path components and walk them in order, maintaining a running absolute path normalized after each step. If the running path ever leaves reports_root, raise ValueError. If any stepped-into path—including the final file—is a symbolic link, raise ValueError. After validating the full path, open it as a UTF-8 text file, read the contents, and return them. Allow FileNotFoundError from opening a missing ordinary file to propagate.
END_PLAN
